meta_description: Golden paths turn engineering months into days — and make the secure path the easy path.

blocks.x: Golden paths turn engineering months into days — and make the secure path the easy path.

Platform engineering is the highest-leverage hire you will make is not a slogan; it is a delivery position. The evidence is consistent across industries — the constraint is rarely technology; it is whether the operating model takes this seriously from sprint one.

items: Backstage-class catalogs with scorecards make ownership visible and drift actionable.
DORA metrics belong on the platform team's roadmap, not just engineering's vanity dashboard.
Platform-as-product (roadmap, budget, NPS) separates adopted platforms from routed-around ones.

blocks.x: Three questions to ask your current vendors

items: Where exactly does the evidence for each claim live — and can your auditor reach it without a project?
Which named individual owns the control environment around this capability — not the function, the person?
What did you stop last quarter, and what did the stop save us?

blocks.x: Programs stall when the operating model is treated as an afterthought — the technology works in week six and the organization has not changed in week sixty, so the capability Silently degrades into shelfware.

items: Pre-agreed criteria and locked baselines before build; the demo is the least important artifact.
Named owners, run models and escalation paths agreed with the operating team, not for it.
Replay trails, control tests and documentation as artifacts of the build — never reconstructed.

blocks.x: Paved-road services typically see lead time fall 50%+ with change-failure rate falling alongside.
